title: Overnight sign-in alert on ic-auth01
brief: Ironcrest Industries runs a Linux jump host, ic-auth01, that staff reach over SSH. The SOC received a low-priority alert about unusual sign-in activity overnight. You have the day's authentication log, the company password policy, the lockout settings and the account list. Work like an analyst: use the filter box in the log to look for patterns, pin the lines that support your answer, then answer the questions. Use evidence, not guesses.

sources.name: Password policy (excerpt)
sources.content:
IRONCREST INDUSTRIES  |  ACCOUNT AND PASSWORD POLICY v3.2 (excerpt)

3.1  Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.
3.2  Passwords must include upper case, lower case, a number and a symbol.
3.3  Passwords expire every 180 days. The last 5 passwords cannot be reused.
3.4  An account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-ins within 15 minutes.
3.5  Multi-factor authentication is required for remote access to systems that hold client data.
     Status on ic-auth01: planned for Q1 (not yet enforced).
3.6  Staff must not share accounts. Service accounts may not be used interactively.
